name: designscore-suggestions-simple
description: IXT-SUITES batch 4: suggestions (pro) flag — the Design Score panel's own 'Suggestions' sub-section (contextual what-to-add tips), gated by a SEPARATE flag nested inside the already-pro-gated #designScorePanel. Proves the sub-flag independently: toggling `suggestions` off leaves the panel mounted (score/category rows still render) but hides only the tips block.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-simple-hidden
steps.failMessage: suggestions should be OFF in Simple mode

steps.name: assert-pro-on
steps.failMessage: designScore + suggestions should both be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: panel-visible
steps.failMessage: Design score panel did not mount

steps.name: suggestions-visible
steps.failMessage: Suggestions sub-section should render for a totally-empty flat (every habitable room fires its empty-room tip)

steps.name: assert-tip-count
steps.eval: (() => { const panel = document.querySelector('#designScorePanel'); const tips = [...panel.querySelectorAll('.ci-detail')].filter(el => el.textContent.includes('💡')); if (tips.length === 0) throw new Error('expected at least one 💡 suggestion line'); })()

steps.name: assert-panel-still-mounted
steps.failMessage: Design score panel should stay mounted when only the nested suggestions flag flips off

steps.name: assert-suggestions-gone
steps.eval: (() => { const panel = document.querySelector('#designScorePanel'); if (panel.textContent.includes('Suggestions')) throw new Error('Suggestions sub-section should be gone once the suggestions flag is off'); })()

steps.name: assert-suggestions-back
steps.failMessage: Suggestions should reappear once the flag is re-enabled

steps.name: back-to-simple
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.resetFeatureFlags(); s.setUiMode('simple'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags(); })()
